84811: Kuro is a Servamp ( a vampire + servant). He was named Kuro, by his Eve, Mahiru Shirota, is the Servamp of Sloth. He is the oldest of the eight Servamps. When he is exposed to sunlight, he transforms into a black cat.
87273: Mahiru is the protagonist of the Servamp series. He is a freshman in high school who likes to keep things simple. He is the eve of Sleepy Ash and the one to name him Kuro.
121995: Tetsu Sendagaya is the Eve of Old Child, the Servamp of Pride. He works at a family-owned hot springs resort. Although he is only 14, he is often mistaken for a university student because of his great stature and muscular figure.
121996: He is the older brother of Misono Arisuin.
121997: Servamp of Lust, servamp of Misono.
121998: At first meet, he seems to be arrogant, impolite and cold towards others. This only covers up his otherwise kind and caring personality. Despite his offbeat and arrogant character, Misono is shown to care for his friends deeply.
122010: Lawless is the Servamp of Greed and has a contract with a famous pianist Licht Jekylland Todoroki. He is a strong Servamp who often quotes Shakespeare and has a habit of killing his Eves once he grows bored of them. Lawless is self-centred and particularly emotional.
122011: Licht Jekylland Todoroki, also refered to as Licht Todoroki, is a famous pianist from Austria who thinks he's an angel. He is the Eve of "Lawless", the Servamp of Greed. Although Licht is already 18 years old, he often behaves like a naive child.
122012: Tsubaki is the main antagonist at the beginning of the story. He is the 8th Servamp who should, originally, not exist - that may be the reason the other Servamps did not know of him at the beginning. He is also called "Who is coming?" Tsubaki is the Servamp of Melancholy.
122013: Belkia is one of Tsubaki's subclass and also one of his best friends. Belkia is rather eccentric with his appearance. He has long pink hair tied back in a ponytail with matching glasses. He wears a white suit with a white top hat as well.
122044: Tsurugi Kamiya is a member of C3, a greatly feared neutral organization among vampires. He has pale skin and is smaller than his teammates at C3. He is often seen wearing his C3 uniform, which resembles a straitjacket.
135818: Sakuya Watanuki is Mahiru Shirota's best friend.
205904: Second oldest of the servamps and he is the servamp of pride. His eve is "Tetsu Sendagaya" and he only choosed him because his blood tastes good.
230123: The Mother is the Servamp of Wrath and the fourth oldest of the eight Servamps. The Mother is currently under a temporary contract with Izuna Nobel as her Eve. She is also the only female Servamp.
